The petitioner no.1 has agreed to pay Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) to the respondent no.2 towards full and final satisfaction of all her claims/legal entitlements (past,
present and future) arising out of marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no. 2 including permanent alimony/maintenance/istridhan etc. and other miscellaneous and legal expenses.
